_about: Hand-maintained fixes to TEC register matching (pipeline/tec_match.py). 'match' forces a TEC project (its Project ID) onto a list of REPD IDs; an empty list confirms it is not in REPD. 'noMatch' stops a TEC project being matched to one REPD ID. Each entry gives a reason. An entry whose TEC project or REPD record has gone is skipped and flagged in the pipeline report.
